name: app-black-problem-statement-slide-with-large-sans
title: Problem statement on pure black with one large light sans paragraph
whatItIs: A black slide with a small grey label 'PROBLEM STATEMENT', a huge centred three-line white sans statement about caregivers balancing rest, and a short grey paragraph beneath.
whatItMeans: Serious and clear; nothing competes with the sentence.
techniques: Set the whole slide as one big statement.
Use a tiny grey label above.
Keep supporting text short and dimmer.

vocabulary.definition: A slide built from one key sentence.
A tiny caps label above a headline.
White for primary, grey for secondary text.
